title: Our Future Health — Imputed genotype data — Imputed VCF
description: Array of Our Future Health genetic data records. One element is one record of the imputed VCF files (ofh_imputed.v6.chrZ-bXXXX.vcf.gz): the genotype and genotype probability of one sample at one variant.
$comment: Describes the columns of the source file as a table of rows; the files themselves are TSV, text or VCF (D124). A value absent in the source is -998 (the string "-998" for text), D021. Cross-table links to participant.PID cannot be enforced (D102).
